Overview

Muharraq has a population of 200,000. Muharraq is a major city in Bahrain with a population of 200,000. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 269 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
